title: Who is missing from this list?

commenti.body:
It depends on what you want to include in the list. The best directors or the most influential. 

3 of my favourite directors are missing: Masaki Kobayashi, Hayao Miyazaki and Satoshi Kon. 

Furthermore in any such lists you can never miss the silent masters Charlie Chaplin, Buster Keaton and D.W. Griffith.

whoever you didn't list that's on a list like this:  
[https://theyshootpictures.com/directors.htm](https://theyshootpictures.com/directors.htm)  
that should get you a few more names

my favorites you're missing: alan rudolph, rivette, de Oliveira, raul ruiz, hartley, lanthimos, so many mooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooooore

Well for one, if you just focus on directors, you are subscribing to an auteurist myth about movies - that directorship is the lens through which great movies are identified. It doesn't give enough credit to producers, production companies, writers and actors.

Secondly, there is no Fritz Lang. Even you ignore silent directors, you still can't ignore Lang.

Thirdly, big gaps in Asian cinema. Hou Hsiao Hsien, Tsai Ming Liang, Edward Yang, Jia Zhanke, Zhang Yimou from China, and Shinji Somai, Naruse, Miyazaki, and Kawashima from Japan.
